description:
src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr is 531 lines and violates SRP: DNS cache, HTTP execution, redirect chain, error mapping, header building, SSL context, semaphore, circuit breaker, and rate limiter are all in one class. Refactor into focused units with no breaking public API changes.

Key findings:
1. Class-level DNS cache state (5 class vars, eviction, cleanup proc, registered flag) — extract to Fetcher::DnsCache module/class
2. build_headers / with_cache are pure header utilities — move to HeaderBuilder
3. handle_redirects + perform_follow_redirect both call Crest::Request.execute with the same options — extract execute_crest
4. DRY violation in handle_request_failed: identical case statement duplicated for error + wrapper
5. transition_domain only called when domains differ but record_success also called unconditionally later
6. extract_domain private method just delegates to @validator
7. DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER constant defined mid-file, magic number 10_000
8. clear_dns_cache class method unnecessarily constructs a new client
9. SafeFeedProcessor::MAX_FEED_SIZE check embedded in perform_request (feed concern in HTTP client)
10. Uncommitted spec/dns_cache_spec.cr require line — include in landing

Public API surface (must NOT break):
- Fetcher::CrestHttpClient.new(config, validator?)
- .new, .build_headers, .with_cache, .clear_rate_limiters, .clear_dns_cache
- .dns_max_entries / .dns_max_entries=
- #head, #get, #clear_dns_cache (instance)

Callers in src/: fetcher.cr (88,89,126,127,153), json_feed.cr:19, rss.cr:23, youtube.cr (82,118,119,139,140), software.cr:179, software/atom_parser.cr:62, software/codeberg.cr (14,30), software/github.cr (11,18,33), software/gitlab.cr (12,20), reddit.cr:134

Tests touching API: spec/crest_http_client_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_di_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_cache_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_redirect_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_ssrf_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_rebinding_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_rebinding_flow_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_error_handling_spec.cr, spec/crest_http_client_extract_redirect_spec.cr, spec/redirects_spec.cr, spec/redirects_psl_spec.cr, spec/dns_cache_spec.cr
title: Refactor CrestHttpClient for SRP and reliability
